description: This file defines the `OverlayWindowBuilder` class, which provides a builder pattern for creating and displaying overlay windows in an Android environment suited for accessibility features. The class allows customization of size, position, background color, and touch interactions for the overlay.

classes.name: OverlayWindowBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and showing a customizable overlay window in an Android accessibility service context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to initialize the builder with a content view.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the width and height of the overlay window.

methods.name: setGravity
methods.description: Specifies the gravity (positioning) of the overlay window.

methods.name: setRelativePosition
methods.description: Sets the relative X and Y coordinates for positioning the overlay.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the overlay window.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Builds and displays the overlay window with the specified properties.
